lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 12 vertical columns of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized in 4-5 horizontal rows extending from the posterior gill margin to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal alignment of blobs to create a distinct grid-like rectilinear pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp intensity gradient, characterized by high-luminance superior edges and shadowed inferior boundaries.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily within the ventral and posterior margins of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, high-contrast linear shapes trailing from the ventral region near the pelvic fins, consistent with commensal organisms.
